banner.title: Your cookie choices
banner.body: We load measurement and advertising cookies, and tell Meta and Google whether an ad led you to sign up, only if you accept. Refusing changes nothing about how the site works.

notice.title: Your privacy choices
notice.body: We use measurement and advertising cookies to see how our ads perform, and tell Meta and Google whether an ad led you to sign up.

prefs.title: Choose by purpose
prefs.intro: Turn each purpose on or off. We keep your choice for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}, and you can change it any time from the footer.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.body: Your language, your country, and this choice itself. A random identifier records your choices, and can be linked to the account you create.

analytics.title: Audience measurement
analytics.body: Google Analytics, to see which pages bring us new businesses.

marketing.title: Advertising
marketing.body: Meta, to know which of our ads actually led somewhere. If you create an account, Meta also receives your contact details as an irreversible code, to recognize you.

us.title: Your Privacy Choices
us.intro: Turn off what you don't want us to share or measure. A refusal is kept for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} and renews each time you visit. To change it, come back to “{choices}” at the bottom of any page.

gpc.statusAll: Your browser's Global Privacy Control signal is on, and we honor it: advertising and audience measurement are off.
gpc.statusAdvertising: Your browser's Global Privacy Control signal is on, and we honor it: advertising is off.

marketing.title: Sale, sharing and targeted advertising
marketing.body: Meta, to know which of our ads led to a sign-up. If you create an account, Meta also receives your contact details as an irreversible code, to recognize you. Turned off, nothing is sent to Meta.

analytics.title: Audience measurement
analytics.body: Google Analytics, to see which pages bring us new businesses. Google handles this data on our behalf only.
